notes.title: New localisation update!
notes.content:
Hello Full Void Community!

For all our players out there, we've got you covered! Full Void is now rolling out in even more languages. 🌍🎮

While Full Void immerses you in its adventure mainly through atmospheric storytelling and evocative sounds, we've now localized the achievements and the UI of the game.

[b]New Languages Available! 🌍[/b]
Based on your feedback, Full Void is now available in:

French 🇫🇷
Spanish 🇪🇸
Portuguese 🇵🇹🇧🇷
Turkish 🇹🇷

With this, Full Void now supports a total of 7 languages, including the previously available English 🇬🇧, German 🇩🇪, and Italian 🇮🇹. This ensures that more players can dive into the game with a familiar touch.

[b]Ready to Dive In?[/b]
Jump into the world of Full Void and let the pixels do the talking! Whether you're dodging obstacles or unraveling mysteries, it's all in a day's play. And now, it speaks your language. 😉

[b]We'd Love Your Feedback[/b]
If you have any comments about the new localizations or run into any issues, please reach out. We're here to help and ensure a smooth gaming experience for everyone.

[b]What's Next?[/b]
We're always looking to improve Full Void. In conclusion, we'd love to hear from you about which other languages you'd like to see the game translated into. Your input will guide our future updates.

Thank you for being a part of the Full Void community. Happy gaming!

Best wishes,
The OutOfTheBit Team
